title: Overtaught, Underlearned: Learner-Centered Distillation from Multi-Agent Discussion
abstract: arXiv:2610.16543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent discussion produces reasoning collaboratively, while deployment still relies on a smaller student that must answer alone. Full-graph distillation transfers such discussions by treating each correct solution as a separate training target, but what teachers provide need not match what the student learns. This mismatch appears in two ways: several correct solutions may amount to the same lesson in the student's representation (over-teaching), while some training questions remain missed after learning (under-learning). We quantify both with rates that are high on discussion graphs. To address them, we introduce FAR (Fold--Attempt--Revisit), a learner-centered distillation procedure that organizes supervision around the student's own state. translated_title: 教之过甚，学之不足：基于多智能体讨论的以学习者为中心的蒸馏
translated_abstract: 多智能体讨论以协作方式产生推理，而部署时仍依赖于一个必须独立作答的更小学生模型。全图蒸馏通过将每个正确解视为独立的训练目标来传递此类讨论，但教师所提供的内容未必与学生实际学到的东西相匹配。这种不匹配体现在两个方面：多个正确解在学生的表示中可能相当于同一课（过度教学，over-teaching），而某些训练问题在学习之后仍然被遗漏（学习不足，under-learning）。我们用两个比率对这两种现象进行量化，它们在讨论图上都处于较高水平。为解决这些问题，我们提出了FAR（折叠—尝试—重访，Fold–Attempt–Revisit），这是一种以学习者为中心的蒸馏流程，它围绕学生自身状态来组织监督信号。在训练之前，FAR将每个讨论状态内的多个解折叠为具有代表性的课；在训练之后，学生自身的尝试用于识别被遗漏的问题，而表示不佳的聚类……
tldr: 该论文提出以学习者为中心的蒸馏方法FAR，通过在训练前将冗余解折叠为代表性课、在训练后利用学生自身尝试识别并重访遗漏问题，来解决多智能体讨论蒸馏中“过度教学”与“学习不足”的不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FAR (Fold–Attempt–Revisit), a learner-centered distillation method that folds redundant solutions into representative lessons before training and uses the student's own attempts after training to identify and revisit missed questions, addressing the mismatch of over-teaching and under-learning in multi-agent discussion distillation.
